All fixtures are synthetic and contain no original customer documents.

- OCR images are generated by `scripts/generate-fixtures.py` from invented rows. Set `MONEYSAVER_TEST_FONT` to a Hebrew-capable TrueType font when generating on another OS. Pillow is needed only for regeneration.
- `mortgage-annual.txt` is generated by `scripts/generate-mortgage-fixture.mjs` exclusively from invented balances and payments, retaining reversed decimals, tabs, truncation, and split labels to exercise PDF extraction regressions.
- `payslip-sample.pdf` is a generated sample with invented identifiers and internally consistent sample amounts.
- `approved-assets.json` records reviewed binary hashes. Changed or new binary fixtures are blocked until reviewed and explicitly reapproved.

Never generate fixtures from private database rows, screenshots, or financial documents.
